<style>

.semicon-youtube-actions-title{margin:0;color:#fff;font-size:1.08rem;font-weight:800;line-height:1.5}
.semicon-youtube-actions .semicon-youtube-actions-copy{margin:.35rem 0 0;color:#edf8fa;font-size:.84rem;line-height:1.65}
.semicon-youtube-actions-links{display:grid;gap:.55rem;margin-top:.85rem}
.semicon-youtube-action{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:48px;padding:.7rem .9rem;border:2px solid #fff;border-radius:9px;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:800;line-height:1.4;text-align:center;transition:transform .15s ease,box-shadow .15s ease,background-color .15s ease}

.semicon-youtube-action-primary{background:#fff;color:var(--sy-navy)!important;box-shadow:0 6px 14px rgba(16,35,63,.18)}

.semicon-youtube-section-title{margin:1.5rem 0 .7rem;padding-left:.7rem;border-left:5px solid var(--sy-cyan);color:var(--sy-navy);font-size:1.25rem;line-height:1.45}

</style>

<script>
(function(){
  var youtubeCtaNavigationPending=false;

  function closeToc(){
    var tocCheckbox=document.getElementById('toc-checkbox-1');
    if(tocCheckbox){
      tocCheckbox.checked=false;
      tocCheckbox.removeAttribute('checked');
    }
  }
  if(!document.getElementById('toc-checkbox-1')){
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',closeToc,{once:true});
  }else{
    closeToc();
  }

  document.addEventListener('click',function(event){
    var target=event.target;
    var link=target&&typeof target.closest==='function' ? target.closest('a[data-youtube-cta-id]') : null;
    if(!link||typeof window.gtag!=='function') return;

    var ctaId=link.getAttribute('data-youtube-cta-id')||'';
    if(ctaId!=='primary_continue'&&ctaId!=='secondary_basics') return;

    var parameters={
      cta_id:ctaId,
      cta_label:(link.textContent||'').trim().replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,120),
      page_path:location.pathname
    };
    var shouldDelayNavigation=ctaId==='secondary_basics'&&!event.defaultPrevented&&
      (event.button===undefined||event.button===0)&&!event.metaKey&&!event.ctrlKey&&!event.shiftKey&&!event.altKey&&
      !link.hasAttribute('download')&&(!link.target||link.target==='_self');

    if(shouldDelayNavigation){
      event.preventDefault();
      if(youtubeCtaNavigationPending) return;
      youtubeCtaNavigationPending=true;
      var destination=link.href;
      var navigationCompleted=false;
      var navigationRequested=false;
      var minimumDelayElapsed=false;
      var continueNavigation=function(){
        if(navigationCompleted) return;
        navigationCompleted=true;
        window.location.assign(destination);
      };
      var requestNavigation=function(){
        navigationRequested=true;
        if(minimumDelayElapsed) continueNavigation();
      };
      parameters.transport_type='beacon';
      parameters.event_callback=requestNavigation;
      parameters.event_timeout=800;
      window.setTimeout(function(){
        minimumDelayElapsed=true;
        if(navigationRequested) continueNavigation();
      },350);
      window.setTimeout(continueNavigation,900);
    }

    window.gtag('event','youtube_landing_cta_click',parameters);
  },true);
})();
</script>
